# ZEC Apps

ZEC Apps are small iPhone apps from ZEC Inc. for everyday records, quick checks, travel, family routines, widgets, and focused utilities.

Canonical app index: https://zec-inc.jp/apps/

## Main Apps
- Foot Size Check: Measure foot length and width from a photo, using a sheet of A4 paper as the size reference. https://zec-inc.jp/apps/foot-size-check/
- DailyAlbum: One Photo a Day: Keep one photo a day as a simple memory calendar, with notes, widgets, Frame Mode, and free optional... https://zec-inc.jp/apps/photo-day/
- Big Text Note: Write one large, easy-to-read note for quick display, reminders, labels, and simple communication. https://zec-inc.jp/apps/big-text-note/
- Mute Video Before Share: Remove all sound from a video in one tap — no re-encoding, no quality loss, no length limit, no watermark. https://zec-inc.jp/apps/mute-video-before-share/
- Study Buddy Timer: One-tap study stopwatch that tracks daily study time and turns minutes into EXP and levels for a buddy. https://zec-inc.jp/apps/study-buddy-timer/
- CleanURL Tap - Tidy Long Links: Clean copied links by removing common tracking clutter before saving, opening, or sharing them. https://zec-inc.jp/apps/cleanurl-tap/
- Hong Kong Phrase Card: 160 offline Cantonese travel phrase cards for Hong Kong — show large Traditional Chinese text or play speech. https://zec-inc.jp/apps/hong-kong-phrase-card/
